description: Land Acquisition - Kuruniyawatta, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (lots 1-11) for public purpose, including descriptions of each property, assessment numbers, extents, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" specifically covering "land acquisitions" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
